answer: A reputation bond makes Sybil attacks expensive: each agent must lock a stake in a shared escrow before it can trade, like an oasis that only travellers who leave water behind may use. To forge a thousand fake identities then costs a thousand stakes, while honest agents earn theirs back with interest. A newcomer with no history drifts like a zephyr, visible but carrying no weight, until it proves itself through small, verified trades.
